   1 class_name MaterializationSystem extends System
   2 
   3 @export var runtime: Node = null
   4 var materialization_count: int = 0
   5 
   6 func setup() -> void:
   7 	assert(is_instance_valid(runtime))
   8 
   9 func query() -> QueryBuilder:
  10 	return q.with_all([C_Transform, C_RoomMember]).with_any([C_Body, C_Visual]).enabled()
  11 
  12 func process(entities: Array[Entity], _components: Array, _delta: float) -> void:
  13 	if not runtime.in_safe_flush:
  14 		runtime.schedule_flush()
  15 		return
  16 	if not is_instance_valid(runtime.camera):
  17 		var camera := Camera2D.new()
  18 		camera.name = "RoomCamera"
  19 		camera.position_smoothing_enabled = false
  20 		runtime.add_child(camera)
  21 		runtime.camera = camera
  22 	for entity in entities:
  23 		if not entity.enabled:
  24 			continue
  25 		var body: C_Body = entity.get_component(C_Body)
  26 		var visual: C_Visual = entity.get_component(C_Visual)
  27 		if (body != null and body.ready and is_instance_valid(body.root)) or (body == null and visual != null and is_instance_valid(visual.node)):
  28 			continue
  29 		var resource: Resource = null
  30 		if visual != null and visual.kind != "effect":
  31 			resource = runtime.resources.resolve(visual.asset_id)
  32 			if resource == null:
  33 				runtime.fail(runtime.resources.last_error)
  34 				continue
  35 		var root: Node2D
  36 		match body.kind if body != null else "none":
  37 			"character":
  38 				root = CharacterBody2D.new()
  39 				root.floor_snap_length = 8.0
  40 				root.safe_margin = 0.05
  41 			"static":
  42 				root = StaticBody2D.new()
  43 			_:
  44 				root = Node2D.new()
  45 		root.name = "Body" if body != null and body.kind != "none" else "VisualRoot"
  46 		root.visible = false
  47 		if root is CollisionObject2D:
  48 			root.collision_layer = 0
  49 			root.collision_mask = 0
  50 			var shape := CollisionShape2D.new()
  51 			shape.name = "Collision"
  52 			var rectangle := RectangleShape2D.new()
  53 			rectangle.size = body.size
  54 			shape.shape = rectangle
  55 			shape.position = body.offset
  56 			shape.disabled = true
  57 			root.add_child(shape)
  58 			body.shape = shape
  59 		entity.add_child(root)
  60 		if body != null:
  61 			body.root = root
  62 		if visual != null:
  63 			if not _make_visual(root, visual, resource):
  64 				root.queue_free()
  65 				if body != null:
  66 					body.root = null
  67 				continue
  68 		var interaction: C_Interaction = entity.get_component(C_Interaction)
  69 		if interaction != null:
  70 			var prompt := Label.new()
  71 			prompt.name = "InteractionPrompt"
  72 			prompt.text = "E · " + interaction.prompt
  73 			prompt.add_theme_font_override("font", runtime.resources.resolve("ui_cjk_font"))
  74 			prompt.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 23)
  75 			prompt.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(1.0, 0.90, 0.57))
  76 			prompt.add_theme_color_override("font_outline_color", Color(0.06, 0.02, 0.12))
  77 			prompt.add_theme_constant_override("outline_size", 8)
  78 			prompt.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
  79 			prompt.position = Vector2(-280, -150)
  80 			prompt.size = Vector2(560, 50)
  81 			prompt.z_index = 40
  82 			prompt.visible = false
  83 			root.add_child(prompt)
  84 		if entity.get_component(C_Boss) != null:
  85 			var bar := ProgressBar.new()
  86 			bar.name = "BossHealth"
  87 			bar.position = Vector2(-240, -330)
  88 			bar.size = Vector2(480, 18)
  89 			bar.show_percentage = false
  90 			bar.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
  91 			root.add_child(bar)
  92 			var title := Label.new()
  93 			title.name = "BossTitle"
  94 			title.position = Vector2(-260, -370)
  95 			title.size = Vector2(520, 36)
  96 			title.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
  97 			title.add_theme_font_override("font", runtime.resources.resolve("ui_cjk_font"))
  98 			title.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 24)
  99 			title.add_theme_constant_override("outline_size", 6)
 100 			root.add_child(title)
 101 		if body != null:
 102 			body.ready = true
 103 		materialization_count += 1

 105 func _make_visual(root: Node2D, visual: C_Visual, resource: Resource) -> bool:
 106 	var node: Node2D
 107 	if visual.kind == "animated":
 108 		if not resource is SpriteFrames:
 109 			runtime.fail("Animated visual requires SpriteFrames: " + visual.asset_id)
 110 			return false
 111 		var sprite := AnimatedSprite2D.new()
 112 		sprite.sprite_frames = resource
 113 		sprite.scale = Vector2.ONE * (0.49 if visual.asset_id == "heroine_frames" else 1.0)
 114 		sprite.offset = visual.offset
 115 		if visual.asset_id == "dealer_frames" and visual.tint.a < 1.0:
 116 			var equipment := Sprite2D.new()
 117 			equipment.name = "SpectralCard"
 118 			equipment.texture = runtime.resources.resolve("enemy_card")
 119 			equipment.scale = Vector2(28, 42) / equipment.texture.get_size()
 120 			equipment.position = Vector2(32, -64)
 121 			equipment.modulate = Color(0.65, 0.9, 1.0)
 122 			root.add_child(equipment)
 123 		node = sprite
 124 	elif visual.kind == "effect":
 125 		var line := Line2D.new()
 126 		line.width = 3.0
 127 		line.antialiased = true
 128 		var effect: C_Effect = root.get_parent().get_component(C_Effect)
 129 		var points := PackedVector2Array()
 130 		if effect.kind == "slash":
 131 			for i in 17:
 132 				var angle: float = lerpf(-1.35, 1.35, float(i) / 16.0)
 133 				points.append(Vector2(cos(angle), sin(angle)) * effect.size * 0.5)
 134 		elif effect.kind == "slam_warning":
 135 			var half: Vector2 = effect.size * 0.5
 136 			points = PackedVector2Array([Vector2(-half.x, -half.y), Vector2(half.x, -half.y), half, Vector2(-half.x, half.y), -half])
 137 		elif effect.kind == "telegraph" or effect.kind.ends_with("warning"):
 138 			for i in 25:
 139 				var angle: float = TAU * float(i) / 24.0
 140 				points.append(Vector2(cos(angle), sin(angle)) * effect.size * 0.5)
 141 		else:
 142 			for i in 17:
 143 				var angle: float = TAU * float(i) / 16.0
 144 				var radius: float = 0.5 if i % 2 == 0 else 0.18
 145 				points.append(Vector2(cos(angle), sin(angle)) * effect.size * radius)
 146 		if effect.kind.ends_with("warning"):
 147 			var warning := Label.new()
 148 			warning.name = "AttackWarning"
 149 			warning.z_index = 40
 150 			warning.text = "落掌 · 跃起或闪避" if effect.kind == "slam_warning" else ("卡牌扇 · 准备闪避" if effect.kind == "fan_warning" else "绯月狂宴 · 第二阶段")
 151 			warning.position = Vector2(-190, -90)
 152 			warning.size = Vector2(380, 40)
 153 			warning.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
 154 			warning.add_theme_font_override("font", runtime.resources.resolve("ui_cjk_font"))
 155 			warning.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 24)
 156 			warning.add_theme_constant_override("outline_size", 8)
 157 			root.add_child(warning)
 158 		line.points = points
 159 		node = line
 160 	elif visual.kind == "platform":
 161 		var strip := Node2D.new()
 162 		var count: int = int(visual.draw_size.x / 160.0)
 163 		for index in count:
 164 			var asset: String = "platform_left" if index == 0 else ("platform_right" if index == count - 1 else "platform_middle")
 165 			var texture: Resource = runtime.resources.resolve(asset)
 166 			if not texture is AtlasTexture:
 167 				strip.free()
 168 				runtime.fail("Platform requires AtlasTexture: " + asset)
 169 				return false
 170 			var segment := Sprite2D.new()
 171 			segment.name = "Segment%02d" % index
 172 			segment.texture = texture
 173 			segment.centered = false
 174 			segment.position = Vector2(index * 160, -6)
 175 			strip.add_child(segment)
 176 		node = strip
 177 	else:
 178 		if not resource is Texture2D:
 179 			runtime.fail("Sprite visual requires Texture2D: " + visual.asset_id)
 180 			return false
 181 		var sprite := Sprite2D.new()
 182 		sprite.texture = resource
 183 		if visual.draw_size != Vector2.ZERO:
 184 			sprite.scale = visual.draw_size / sprite.texture.get_size()
 185 		sprite.position = visual.offset
 186 		node = sprite
 187 	node.name = "Visual"
 188 	node.z_index = visual.z_index
 189 	node.modulate = visual.tint
 190 	root.add_child(node)
 191 	visual.node = node
 192 	return true
